faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.contactText: Couldn't find the answer you were looking for? Reach us instantly via our WhatsApp support line or at our information desk on competition day. We are happy to help.

items.q: When should I make my booking?
items.a: To help us plan the shoot properly, we recommend pre-booking on our website. Registrations are also accepted at our stand on competition day, but pre-booked athletes have priority.

After choosing your package and making your pre-booking on our website, you can complete your payment at our stand on competition day (cash or credit card). Bookings with completed payment are added to the shooting list.

items.q: Do you only take photos, or do you also shoot video?
items.a: Yes, we offer both photo and video. You can choose photo only, video only, or our value packages that include both.

items.q: How can I be sure my child will be filmed?
items.a: Booked athletes are tracked using the competition start list. Our professional team is ready when a booked athlete's turn comes and records the performance from start to finish.

items.q: Do you offer a refund if there is a technical problem or I don't like the photos?
items.a: Customer satisfaction comes first. If your performance cannot be delivered due to a technical error on our side (loss of focus, data corruption, etc.), we guarantee a 100% refund.

items.q: Do you only deliver digitally, or are albums or frames available?
items.a: Our standard delivery is digital for the fastest access. On request, you can contact our team after the competition for printed products such as custom posters, canvas prints or memory albums.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: Yes. With the account you create during booking, you can track your orders, access your personal gallery when your content is ready, and book faster at future competitions by signing in without re-entering your details.

items.q: Do I have to book before the competition?
items.a: We recommend booking in advance. This way the athlete's details reach our team beforehand and everything moves faster on competition day.
Yes. Sign in to your account to view your booking details and easily make any changes you need.
